export.title: Export diary
export.fullBackupDescription: Entries and locally stored photos in an importable ZIP backup.
export.lightweightBackupDescription: Entries without local photo files. Existing cloud photo links are preserved.
export.csvDescription: A localized spreadsheet-friendly file for viewing and sharing. CSV cannot be imported.

scope.title: What to export
scope.allDescription: Export all diary entries available locally.
scope.periodDescription: Export entries within a selected date range.
scope.selectedDescription: Choose individual diary entries to export.

errors.empty: There are no diary entries in this scope.

progress.waitingDescription: The active diary operation must finish first.
progress.preparingDescription: Reading current SQLite rows and creating entry data.
progress.locked: Diary changes and synchronization are temporarily locked.

result.title: Export complete
result.description: The file is ready to save or share.
result.shareFailed: Failed to open the system save or share interface.

preview.title: Backup preview
preview.waitingDescription: The active diary operation must finish before the backup can be checked.
preview.validatingDescription: Validating the archive and checking for matching local entries.
preview.noMatches: No local entries with the same IDs were found.
preview.matchesDescription: {{count}} local entries have the same IDs and require a conflict decision.

errors.unsupportedPlatform: Diary backup import is not available on this platform.
errors.invalidArchive: The selected file is not a valid diary backup ZIP archive.
errors.manifestInvalid: The backup manifest is invalid or does not match the archive contents.
errors.unsupportedVersion: This backup format version is not supported by this version of DOne.
errors.unsafePath: The backup contains an unsafe file path.
errors.chunkMissing: One of the backup entry files is missing.
errors.chunkInvalid: One of the backup entry files is invalid.
errors.entryInvalid: The backup contains an invalid diary entry or photo.
errors.duplicateEntryId: The backup contains duplicate diary entry IDs.
errors.entryCountMismatch: The number of diary entries does not match the backup manifest.
errors.unknown: The backup could not be checked.

conflicts.title: Resolve matches
conflicts.description: Choose what to do with diary entries whose IDs already exist on this device.
conflicts.skipAllDescription: Keep the existing local entries and do not import the matching entries from this backup.
conflicts.replaceAllDescription: Replace every matching local entry with the version stored in this backup.
conflicts.reviewIndividuallyDescription: Choose Skip or Replace separately for each matching diary entry.

progress.title: Import diary
progress.locked: Diary changes and synchronization are temporarily locked.

result.title: Import complete
result.description: The selected backup has been imported into the local diary.
result.partialDescription: A later batch could not be imported. Previously completed batches remain in the diary.
result.failedDescription: No completed import result is available.

review.title: Review matches
review.localDescription: This is the entry currently stored on this device.
review.backupDescription: This is the version contained in the selected backup.
review.ready: All matching entries have a decision.
review.remaining: {{count}} matching entries still need a decision.

files.deleteUnfinishedDescription: The saved export progress will be permanently deleted.
files.deleteFinishedDescription: The created export file will be permanently deleted from this device.
